card.title: Trust with a Trapdoor
card.instruction: Use one person as your anchor while preserving a private condition that could reverse your trust when a recurring detail returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're in charge of my birthday. I know you'll keep it simple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That phrase cost me a weekend in a mascot suit last year.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you can keep planning. Slowly, and without using 'surprise' again.
